body: We would need a way to reliably replicate this so an MRP would be required here

Understood. Since now the issue seems to be project dependent, will find the specific scene that causes the problem, and make a MRP later.

Currently, I am suspecting that some specific scene causes this problem, since UPF usually crashes at 27% or 39%.

### Update (07/25/2026)

Still testing and trying to make an MRP. Currently found that remove the `CONNECT_DEFERRED` flag will make UPF succeed up to 10 times for the same project.
 https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/fb1821384214b901c86793b09150d3e74b37153d/editor/script/script_editor_plugin.cpp#L2205

Built an MRP that causes crashes. Testes 3 iterations:
* First iteration. Crashes at 2/10 UPF.
* Second iteration. Crashes at 5/10 UPF.
* Third iteration. Crashes at 2/10 UPF.

Tested by official build of `4.8-dev2`. Analysis following in later comments.

[mrp__upf_fail.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30369491/mrp__upf_fail.zip)

Update: This MRP could be further shrinked by only let the `AnimationPlayer` to contain a valid `RESET` animation.

Update: Instead of crashing, sometimes, this error that is similar to this, is showing instead:
```
ERROR: In Object of type 'Object': Attempt to connect nonexistent signal 'tree_exited' to callable 'ScriptEditor::_queue_update_script_names'.
ERROR: In Object of type 'Object': Attempt to connect nonexistent signal 'child_entered_tree' to callable 'ScriptEditor::_connect_to_scene_recursive'.
ERROR: core/object/message_queue.cpp:220 - Error calling deferred method: 'ScriptEditor::ScriptEditor::_connect_to_scene_recursive': Cannot convert argument 2 from Object to Object.
```

### Content of MRP

```
1.tscn // With an `AnimationPlayer`, loaded with an animation and `RESET` animation
2.tscn // Nothing here, just for triggering `Main::iteration()`
```

### Test Trace

The parenthesis content before each line, such as `(private)`, stands for the project used for testing.

* (private) `4.8-dev1 official` was working but `4.8-dev2 official` was malfunctioning.
* (private) Used `git bisect` that found *commit A* (bf898d1) is the first-bad commit.
* (private) `4.8-dev2 + logging` showing that crashes happens at `EditorProgress::step` in a for-loop in function `ProjectUpgradeTool::finish_upgrade`. Crash happens before `EditorProgress::step` returns and opening/saving of the next scene.
* (private) `4.8-dev2 + reverted commit A` cannot reproduce (10/10 UPF clear).
* (private) `4.8-dev2 + no CONNECT_DEFERRED for _connect_to_scene_recursive ` cannot reproduce (10/10).
* (private) `4.8-dev2 asan built` showing **heap-use-after-free**. From the log, it is known that the bad-accessed memory was allocated by `AnimationMixer::apply_reset(bool)`, triggered by the `Main::iteration()` from `EditorProgress::step`. 
* (private + with only the scene that with `AnimationPlayer`) `4.8-dev2 official` crashes.
* (mrp) `4.8-dev2 official` crashes (at 2/10, 5/10, 2/10).
* (mrp without `RESET` animation) `4.8-dev2 official` cannot reproduce (10/10)
* (mrp with ONLY the `RESET` animation) `4.8-dev2 official` crashes at 2/10.

### ASAN Report

From the report, along with what is observed before, a timeline could be deduced:
1. Running UPF.
2. A scene that contains `AnimationPlayer` node with a `RESET` animation, was loaded, saved.
3. `AnimationMixer::reset` seems to trying to modify some other nodes, and possibly triggers the tree change and `child_entered_tree` is emitted (*commit A*).
4. A call of `ScriptEditor::_connect_to_scene_recursive` is deferred (*commit A*), and will be trigged by next `Main::iteration()`.
5. The scene is closed and free-ed.
6. A new scene will be loaded. The for-loop in `ProjectUpgradeTool::finish_upgrade`, calls `EditorProgress::step`.
7. `EditorProgress::step` calls eventually `ProgressDialog::_update_ui` in some occasions (since UPF does not always fails at 1/10 UPF testing), which contains `Main::iteration`.
8. Deferred calls are called. But it is attempting to access something that is already free-ed. At this time, the new scene is still not opened yet.

### Conclusion

The crash is caused by node lifetime mismatching (use-after-free), the deferred `_connect_to_scene_recursive` creation, triggered by `AnimationMixer::reset` when doing UPF, and exposed by the calling of `Main::iteration` when stepping to next scene in UPF.

The scene saving process `EditorNode::_save_scene` want to reset the animation before saving.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/bf898d1bb7bfadb98e7ae60e7d76d02920f7d694/editor/editor_node.cpp#L2530-L2531

And an auxiliary animation node is added to the tree to reset.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/bf898d1bb7bfadb98e7ae60e7d76d02920f7d694/scene/animation/animation_mixer.cpp#L2305-L2306

And it is also queue-ed free after it finishes its job.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/bf898d1bb7bfadb98e7ae60e7d76d02920f7d694/scene/animation/animation_mixer.cpp#L2315

### Plans

Maybe dive into `AnimationMixer::reset` to see what is actually allocated, could be a good idea. Also,  maybe it not bad to analyse the usage of `CONNECT_DEFERRED` flag in `ScriptEditor::_connect_to_scene_recursive`, see if it is necessary; or simply disable the script editor trying to find the highlighted scripts when doing UPF (since it is not required to highlight script tab in the script list, when doing UPF)

Need to find what could be the root cause & best solution for this issue. Since it is a lifecycle-related problem.

I am happy to fix it and give a PR !

I can confirm this on 4.8.dev 839de3dfd (Linux) with the MRP on the 6th upgrade, but only on a debug build. An optimized editor build doesn't cause the issue even after 10 upgrades. This is likely a race condition, as it seems to depend on how fast the process is running.
